name: seo-faceted-navigation-audit
summary: Audit ecommerce facets, parameters, crawl paths, canonicals, indexation, links, and crawl traps at explicit sample scope.
inputs: approved crawl, logs, GSC, analytics, sitemap, robots, canonical, link, template, and catalog evidence
external_reads: approved page, crawl, log, provider, catalog, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live page, crawl, log, provider, or catalog reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: robots, canonicals, parameters, sitemaps, CMS, code, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: domain, platform, facets, caps, sample, freshness, source tiers, risks, owners, and rechecks are explicit
complete crawl/index behavior is not claimed from bounded samples
mass indexation recommendations require information-gain and business-purpose evidence
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify no fabricated crawl, log, demand, URL, or index data
verify no robots, canonical, parameter, sitemap, CMS, code, or production mutation occurred
